about: Every field EA's Pro Clubs API sends, what it means and how sure we are of it. Only mark a field 'verified' after checking it against real data, and note the evidence. docs/ea-api.md is generated from this file: run `node scripts/ea-docs.mjs` after editing, and `node scripts/ea-docs.mjs <folder of saved responses>` to list fields EA sends that aren't documented here yet.

thanks.thanks: Thank you for working these out and publishing them.

thanks.file: README.md (event IDs and decoded stat formulas); data/eafc_27_raw_player_data.csv
thanks.thanks: Thank you for decoding and publishing the event counters. Found through Pro Clubs Tracker (proclubstracker.com), which credits it.
thanks.usedFor: interceptions, second assists, through passes, dribbles, aerial duels, fouls and yellow cards from the hidden event counters; offside passes (153); their raw dataset showed counter 191 is not part of missed passes and decoded red cards (96, second yellow) and cross saves (51 + 52); the rating estimate for +CPU lines (lib/rating-model.ts) is trained on its human-only lines

evidence.note: Player lines include both clubs. EA's API keeps only the last 10 matches per type, so everything older exists only in our database (matches.raw).

status.verified: Checked against real data; safe to build on.
status.assumed: Meaning follows from the name or a few examples, not proven.
status.unknown: Seen in the data, meaning not worked out.
status.useless: Always the same value, or contradicts other fields.

api.caching: EA's edge caches identical URLs for minutes; add a unique query param (e.g. _=timestamp)
api.values: almost every number arrives as a string ("54", not 54)

clubs/matches.about: The club's last 10 games of one type, newest first. Each game has both clubs, every human player's line and a total per club. Promotion match games come as leagueMatch. The site saves every game from here (matches.raw), because EA drops them after 10.

timeAgo.number, timeAgo.unit.meaning: how long ago, relative to the request (e.g. 2 hours); not stored

matchEventCounters.format: match_event_aggregate_0..3 hold 'id:count' pairs joined by commas; merge all four strings per player
matchEventCounters.keyFinding: The counters count the HUMAN's own actions. EA's headline goals/assists/shots add the CPU teammates' to the controller's line; the counters don't. So they give real per-player stats even for whoever plays ANY.

214.evidence: equals goals on 89/98 lines; all 9 mismatches are CPU-controller lines where the counter is lower

11.evidence: equals assists on 86/98 lines; all 12 mismatches are CPU-controller lines, counter lower

217.evidence: 217 + 218 equals shots on 85/98 lines; all 13 mismatches are CPU-controller lines, counter lower

215.evidence: in-game Player Performance, Angola fest (13 Oct): dirty8ightt Completed 9 = 215, mo_nm 8 = 215; LA Seigue FC (14 Oct): dirty8ightt 9, mo_nm 8, RUPPADOR 12, x-LadruM-x 11, all = 215. The in-game screen leaves the CPU out (dirty8ightt ran it: 12 passes in game, 60 from EA). Total passes = 215 + 216 + 153 for 3 of 4; mo_nm 13 in game vs 12. EA's passesmade also counts offside passes: 215 + 153 = passesmade on 51 of 58 human-only lines of our club (22 games), the rest within ±2; totals 717 vs 716. On the 13 CPU-controller lines EA is 43–97 higher. A quitter (userResult 6) keeps them while EA wipes passes to 0

153.meaning: offside passes; EA's passesmade counts them as made, the in-game screen as attempted but not completed
153.evidence: dirty8ightt, Angola fest: Offside Passes 1 = 153; Passes 12 = 215 + 216 + 153. El dihbie (16 Oct): Offside Passes 1 = 153, Passes 23 = 215 + 216 + 153; 9 of 9 lines

216.evidence: Angola fest: dirty8ightt 216 = 2 (12 passes, 9 completed, 1 offside), mo_nm 216 = 3 (11 passes, 8 completed); 215 + 216 + 153 = passattempts on 37,819 of 42,451 human-only lines (89.1%) in the EA FC Pro Clubs API research dataset

191.evidence: research dataset, 42,451 human-only lines: adding 191 to 215 + 216 + 153 drops the passattempts match from 89.1% to 86.9%; 1,038 of the 1,252 lines where 191 fires already match without it. Our first guess came from 60 lines

164.screen: dirty8ightt, Angola fest: 2 sliding tackles, 0 won, 164 absent
164.evidence: equals tacklesmade on 56 of 60 human-only lines (totals 62 vs 67); on CPU-controller lines EA is 7–17 higher

derived.cpuGoals: club score minus the sum of counter 214 over the club's players; shown as “CPU” among the scorers on match pages and in Discord posts. Checked on 22 games (44 club-games): when someone runs the CPU, its goals sit on that player's EA line; when nobody does, they appear only in the score (6 goals, all in such games). No counter or club field marks own goals, so an opponent own goal can't be told apart and also lands here
derived.cpuReds: an EA red on a line whose counters have neither 96 (straight red) nor 95 + 213 >= 2 (second yellow) is the CPU's; saved as a corrections row (created_by auto) when the match is first saved, so the club can give it back. 0 misses on the research dataset's 692 human reds
derived.cpuController: the line whose EA goals/assists/shots exceed its counters; failing that, the line whose EA passesmade is 5+ above counters 215 + 153 (EA counts offside passes as made) (the CPU nearly always passes, rarely scores)

Our own 142 lines agree wherever we had checked the same ids (13/18, 14/19, 6, 118, 229, 266, 153). Status 'assumed' until an in-game Player Performance screen confirms them here; checked so far against dirty8ightt (outfield) and mo_nm (GK), Angola fest, 13 Oct.

matchEventCounters.notYetDecoded: tackle attempts: EA's tackleattempts is not the in-game Tackles (standing 0 + 1 plus sliding 120) and has no counter (no counter, pair or triple matches EA's tackleattempts; 15 Oct, research dataset: 164 + event_1 is the best fit but exact on only 38% of 40,449 human-only lines and 55% of lines from games with 11 humans, so about a quarter of attempts have no counter; event_1 looks like missed tackles, above EA's missed on 9 lines only); possession won/lost; players beaten by passes; failed dribbles (212 = 4 = 11 − 7 for dirty8ightt, one line only). In-game Player Performance screens can confirm the fromResearch mappings. Checked 15 Oct against 7 Player Performance screens (Angola fest, LA Seigue FC, SfvErfff), and again 17 Oct with dirty8ightt's El dihbie and Bluvils B screens (9 lines): Possession Won/Lost, Offensive/Defensive Duels, Players Beaten By Passes, Passes Under Pressure, Dribbles attempted, Tackled By Opponent, Beat, Shot Type and Line Breaks match no counter or pair of counters; Key Passes no longer fits 114 (SfvErfff: 2 vs 4). Shot types are not in the counters: no combination adds up to shots in the research dataset.
matchEventCounters.method: for each id compare per-line values with known stats (exact, correlation, pair sums) and check where mismatches fall
